def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):

    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    marker=[c for c,_ in cnt.most_common()][ -1]  # rarest color
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if grid[i][j]==marker]
    r0=min(i for i,j in cells); c0=min(j for i,j in cells)
    shape=[(i-r0,j-c0) for i,j in cells]
    cands=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if all(0<=i+di<H and 0<=j+dj<W and grid[i+di][j+dj] in (0,marker) for di,dj in shape):
                cands.append((i,j))
    taken=set()
    keep=[]
    for i,j in cands:  # row-major
        sc={(i+di,j+dj) for di,dj in shape}
        if sc & taken: continue
        keep.append((i,j)); taken|=sc
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for i,j in keep:
        for di,dj in shape: out[i+di][j+dj]=marker
    return out

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    marker=cnt.most_common()[-1][0]
    mcells={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if grid[i][j]==marker}
    comps=[];seen=set()
    for c in mcells:
        if c in seen: continue
        stack=[c];comp=set()
        while stack:
            p=stack.pop()
            if p in comp: continue
            comp.add(p);seen.add(p)
            i,j=p
            for di in (-1,0,1):
                for dj in (-1,0,1):
                    q=(i+di,j+dj)
                    if q in mcells and q not in comp: stack.append(q)
        comps.append(comp)
    comp=max(comps,key=len)  # template component
    r0=min(i for i,j in comp); c0=min(j for i,j in comp)
    shape=sorted((i-r0,j-c0) for i,j in comp)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            sc=[(i+di,j+dj) for di,dj in shape]
            if all(0<=a<H and 0<=b<W and grid[a][b] in (0,marker) for a,b in sc) \
               and not any((a,b) in comp for a,b in sc):
                for a,b in sc: out[a][b]=marker
    return out

from collections import Counter
from lib import largest_component_cells

def transform(grid):
    """Stamp the rarest-color template shape wherever it occurs in the middle
    (noise) color, except where it would overlap the template itself."""
    cnt = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    marker, noise = cnt.most_common()[-1][0], cnt.most_common()[1][0]
    comp = largest_component_cells(grid, marker)
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    r0 = min(i for i, j in comp); c0 = min(j for i, j in comp)
    shape = sorted((i - r0, j - c0) for i, j in comp)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            sc = [(i + di, j + dj) for di, dj in shape]
            if all(0 <= a < H and 0 <= b < W and grid[a][b] in (noise, marker)
                   for a, b in sc) and not any((a, b) in comp for a, b in sc):
                for a, b in sc:
                    out[a][b] = marker
    return out

    cands=sorted(cands,key=lambda x:-len(x[1]))

def fresh_solve(g):
    from collections import Counter as C2
    Hh,Ww=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=C2(v for r in g for v in r)
    mc=cnt.most_common()
    bg,noi,mk=mc[0][0],mc[1][0],mc[2][0]
    # find all cells of marker
    mcells2=[(i,j) for i in range(Hh) for j in range(Ww) if g[i][j]==mk]
    # largest 8-conn comp
    seen2=set(); best=[]
    for s in mcells2:
        if s in seen2: continue
        stk=[s]; cc=[]
        while stk:
            u=stk.pop()
            if u in seen2: continue
            seen2.add(u); cc.append(u)
            for di2 in (-1,0,1):
                for dj2 in (-1,0,1):
                    v2=(u[0]+di2,u[1]+dj2)
                    if 0<=v2[0]<Hh and 0<=v2[1]<Ww and g[v2[0]][v2[1]]==mk and v2 not in seen2:
                        stk.append(v2)
        if len(cc)>len(best): best=cc
    ri=min(x for x,y in best); rj=min(y for x,y in best)
    shp=sorted((x-ri,y-rj) for x,y in best)
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    stamps=[]
    for i in range(Hh):
        for j in range(Ww):
            cs2=[(i+a2,j+b2) for a2,b2 in shp]
            if all(0<=x<Hh and 0<=y<Ww and g[x][y] in (noi,mk) for x,y in cs2):
                ok=True
                # exclude exact-template placement? keep it (no-op) but exclude partial comp overlaps
                if any(c in set(best) for c in cs2) and not all(c in set(best) for c in cs2):
                    ok=False
                if ok:
                    stamps.append((i,j))
                    for x,y in cs2: out[x][y]=mk
    return out,shp,bg,noi,mk,stamps

import json as J2
def comp8(g,mk):
    Hh,Ww=len(g),len(g[0])
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(Hh) for j in range(Ww) if g[i][j]==mk]
    seen=set(); best=[]
    for s in cells:
        if s in seen: continue
        stk=[s]; cc=[]
        while stk:
            u=stk.pop()
            if u in seen: continue
            seen.add(u); cc.append(u)
            for a in (-1,0,1):
                for b in (-1,0,1):
                    v=(u[0]+a,u[1]+b)
                    if 0<=v[0]<Hh and 0<=v[1]<Ww and g[v[0]][v[1]]==mk and v not in seen: stk.append(v)
        if len(cc)>len(best): best=cc
    return best
